title: Anatomy Impact on RT Breast Cancer
official: Analysis of Anatomical Parameters in the Radiotherapy of Breast Cancer
summary:
Prospective observational study. The purpose of this project is to identify a parameter system that will allow to identify a priori the most appropriate radiotherapy technique for each patient undergoing breast radiotherapy at our center.

All patients will be treated and monitored according to the local clinical practice. A total of at least 30 patients will be included in the study. Dose prescription will be 40.05 Gy (Gray) in 15 fractions.

For each patient, 3 RT treatment plans will be simulated: Three-Dimensional Conformal Radiation Therapy (3D-CRT), Step-and-shoot intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT S\&S), and hybrid technique (3D-CRT+IMRT). A total of 90 plans will be available. The best treatment technique will be chosen based on scoring provided by at least 3 expert clinicians. The primal plan choice will be the one with higher total rate, evaluated as a sum of 3 single rates.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Female
* Target volume: left breast
* Tumor type: any diagnosis of breast cancer
* Dose prescription: 40.05 Gray/15 fractions
* Patients aged ≥ 18 years old
* Patients willing and able to give informed consent to participate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other concomitant tumor lesions
* Sovraclavear lymph node involvement
